visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a crowded convenience store shelf filled with colorful snack packages. A large pink and white text overlay dominates the center. (2) At a Lawson store, the camera focuses on a refrigerated shelf displaying various green matcha-themed desserts from the Morihan collaboration. A hand reaches in to select a wrapped cream puff with a green filling illustration. (3) The scene shifts to a rack of umbrellas. A hand picks up a red-tagged Coleman windproof clear umbrella and opens it partially to show the transparent vinyl material and black logo. (4) Inside a FamilyMart, the camera moves to a freezer case filled with yellow and white pudding parfaits. A hand lifts a cup to show the layered ice cream and pudding inside. (5) On a snack shelf, the camera zooms slightly on black and red bags of Yamayoshi burger-flavored potato chips. A hand grabs a bag to show the burger imagery on the front. (6) At a 7-Eleven, a hand picks up a red Cup Noodle container featuring multiple small chick character faces. The shelf in the background is stocked with various instant noodle brands. (7) The camera pans across boxes of Milky cookies featuring characters from Detective Conan. The packaging is pink and white with chibi-style illustrations of the anime characters. (8) The video concludes with a pink graphic screen containing social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, alongside the Japanuts brand logo and website URL.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, bouncy synthesizer melody begins immediately, featuring staccato 'ba-ba-da' vocalizations used as a rhythmic lead. The tempo is upbeat and consistent. (2) As the cream puff is grabbed, a subtle plastic rustling sound is heard, indicating the physical handling of the package. The music remains at a steady, high-arousal level. (3) A sharp mechanical click and whoosh occur as the umbrella is opened, synchronized with the visual motion. The background music continues its playful loop. (4) A soft thud and plastic friction sound are audible when the pudding cup is lifted from the freezer. The tonal purity of the music is high with a bright spectral profile. (5) Another faint rustle occurs with the potato chips, blending into the percussive elements of the BGM. The track maintains its major mode happy vibe. (6) A metallic/plastic clink accompanies the movement of the Cup Noodle. No human speech is detected throughout the recording. (7) The BGM continues without variation into the final section, where soft handling noises are masked by the persistent rhythmic track. (8) The music fades slightly toward the end as the social media icons appear, maintaining a high-energy conclusion.
